command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$ps=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects'; foreach(`$p in `$ps){ if(`$p.name -match '^CampusNetwork_[0-9]+$'){ `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p.name+'/nodes/Core_SW_01/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; try { `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u).output; `$m=(`$o -split '\r?\n') | Where-Object { `$_ -match '^stp enable|ospf cost|port priority|vrrp vrid [1-6] priority' }; '### '+`$p.name; `$m } catch {} } }"
